title: Swami Vivekanand School of Nursing
description: Professional institutional site for Swami Vivekanand School of Nursing — a premier GNM and ANM nursing institute in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra.
challenge: SVS Nursing had no digital presence to compete with established programs. Prospective students in Aurangabad region couldn't find them online despite the institute's strong faculty and hospital affiliations.
solution: Built a full marketing and information site with program details (GNM & ANM), hospital affiliation listings, digital library highlights, CNE workshop information, and a hostel/facilities section. SEO-optimized for local search.
